proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  have e : n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) * (n + 3) = (n ^ 2 + 3 * n) * (n ^ 2 + 3 * n + 2) := by ring
  rw [e] at hk
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = n ^ 2 + 3 * n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hs] at hk
  have hspos : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; positivity
  have h1 : s < k := by
    by_contra hne
    have : k ≤ s := by omega
    nlinarith
  have h2 : k < s + 1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have : s + 1 ≤ k := by omega
    nlinarith
  omega
